==Description==
'''E-45''' Will be the 3rd entity you may encounter in [[Section E]]. More info shown below.

==Mechanics==
'''E-45''' once spawned will place itself inside a random locker, said locker now being colored differently, and damage anyone who tries to hide in the locker it is in.

==Strategies & tips==

* Check lockers carefully before hiding
* Check the lockers from your left and right
